title: Setup, connections and workflow guides
description: Find Vector OS guides for Windows beta setup, software connections, selected context, Ask, Plan and Build, native approvals and interrupted work.
html:
Help and learning

Find your next step.

Short guides for setup, everyday work and recovery.

16 guides

Getting started

  • Install Vector OSCheck the supplied Windows beta before installing, then keep installation and connection as separate checkpoints.
  • Sign in to Vector OSConfirm the right identity in the browser and finish the separate desktop handoff.
  • Connect your softwareMove from a detected installation to a fresh connection with the exact host and document you chose.

Account

  • Understand plans and creditsRead the published offer, choose the wallet for the next run and distinguish reserved from settled usage.
  • Manage team seatsUse the correct owner account, count reserved invitations and verify membership from the team record.
  • Change or cancel a planReview subscription timing, team capacity and server confirmation before changing or canceling a plan.

Rhino

  • Your first Rhino resultUse a small local practice model to review one bounded Rhino change and inspect its native receipt.

Revit

  • Your first Revit resultReview one supported instance Comments change in a local practice project, then confirm the committed value.

Workspace

  • Choose files and contextChoose the information needed for one request and inspect exactly what will leave your device.
  • Ask, Plan and BuildChoose whether to understand, prepare a change or apply an exact reviewed native plan.

Safety & recovery

  • Review a native approvalReview the exact document, targets and outputs covered by one native approval.
  • Resume after interruptionReturn to the original workspace and inspect each unfinished action before continuing.
  • Resolve an unknown outcomeResolve the outcome of the original operation without applying the same edit again.

Support

  • Export safe diagnosticsCollect a small redacted explanation of a problem, save it locally and choose separately what to share.
  • Update Vector OS and connectorsCheck eligibility, finish uncertain work and verify the new app or connector after a safe restart.
  • Uninstall while retaining projectsRemove only the application and owned connector installation while preserving your projects and recovery evidence.
